Latest dates: a backward pass from the pack deadlines in force at ADD-01 (ATTENDANCE-NOTICE 2026-10-14; CLARIFICATION-CUTOFF 2026-11-12; PDD 2026-11-26 14:00). Total float = Working Days from earliest start to latest start; negative float = INFEASIBLE by that many Working Days (never compressed). Proposal Due Date at this stage: 2026-11-26.
